summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow for Phase 66 (api-schema-cutover-publish-gate-and-tombstone), producing executable PLAN.md files via the full research → pattern-map → plan → verify pipeline.
summary.outcome: Planning completed successfully: 9 plans across 5 waves committed at c0883138e, all 7 requirements and 11 decisions covered, verification passed with 0 blockers. User opted to stop after planning and execute in a separate session.

repo: folder_ipns has zero real SQL FK dependents — shares.ipns_name, vaults.root_ipns_name, and ipns_republish_schedule.ipns_name are plain varchar(255) columns, not FK constraints. Drop-recreate migration order is straightforward without constraint cascading.

upsertFolderIpns in ipns.service.ts is a findOne → gate → save sequence with a confirmed TOCTOU race: two concurrent writers at dbSeq=N both pass the in-memory CAS check, and the second save silently overwrites the first.
No createQueryBuilder().update().execute() pattern exists anywhere in apps/api services yet; it must be written fresh for the atomic CAS path.

Use HttpException({ error: 'IPNS_TOMBSTONED', ipnsName }, HttpStatus.GONE) — NOT GoneException — so the structured body flows through Swagger and pnpm api:generate propagates it into @cipherbox/api-client.
parseCachedRecord (ipns.service.ts L64) treats both expected-null shared-folder rows and CID-mismatch corruption as undifferentiated null, losing the seq-floor behavior required for shared folders.

shares.permission column should be derived from writeDescriptorRef IS NOT NULL rather than stored; unique constraint changes from partial index on (sharer_id, recipient_id, ipns_name) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL to plain UNIQUE (sharer_id, recipient_id, root_node_id).
tombstoneRecord must call republishService.unenrollIpns to remove the name from the republish batch.
API-SURFACE.md intel extraction returns 0 symbols for this repo — it's a no-op; the planner relies on CONTEXT/RESEARCH/PATTERNS instead.
Migration command is: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run (runs typeorm migration:run -d src/data-source.ts); migrations live in apps/api/src/migrations/.

Second existing result.affected usage pattern in the codebase.
persistCallback hook injection is the race-forcing pattern for concurrent CAS tests; used in Phase 64/65 and referenced as the template for Phase 66 tests 16/17.

workflow: GSD commit helper can emit commit_failed as a false-negative even when git confirms the commit landed — verify with git log rather than retrying the commit.
Wave-based execution provides implicit dependency ordering: if plan A is Wave N and plan B is Wave N+1, B need not explicitly list A in depends_on since the executor blocks the wave.
The plan-checker independently resolved an open scope question (66-08 web stubs) without a planner revision loop — verification agents can be used to settle scope ambiguity, not just catch errors.
Drift pre-check results referencing .learnings/, .husky/, landing/, and config files are reliable noise when the phase scope is apps/api only — non-blocking classification is correct in that context.
Pattern mapper with 11/11 analogs found confirms the phase is building on well-trodden patterns; a 0-analog result would have flagged a greenfield risk requiring more detailed spec.

friction: GSD commit helper reported commit_failed false-negative for VALIDATION.md even though git confirmed the commit landed at 5a70cfa09; required manual verification with git log.
